definitions.explanation: Having or showing great skill and expertise, especially in using hands or words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巧|たく}みだ。
{巧|たく}みな⟦{言|い}い{回|まわ}し→言い回し：14146_iimawashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説得|せっとく}した→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He persuaded the other party with clever phrasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巧|たく}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}した→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: The craftsman demonstrated his skillful techniques.
examples.notes: {巧|たく}み as a noun meaning 'skill/technique'

notes:
FORMS:
- {巧|たく}みな + noun - skillful (modifier)
- {巧|たく}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb - skillfully (adverb)
- {巧|たく}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ - skillful technique (noun)

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as たくみ. The kanji {巧|たく}み emphasizes skill; {匠|たくみ} refers to a craftsman/artisan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巧|たく}みな⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧ - skillful speaking
- {巧|たく}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧ - to skillfully manipulate
- {巧|たく}みな⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ - clever lie
- {言葉巧|ことばたく}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - with clever words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ - good at, skilled (more common)
- ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧ - dexterous, handy
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧ - proficient, experienced
